provenance_note: The isolated gateway served the design-critique app built into the Kiro Crew checkout (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/design_critique, website/src/apps/design-critique): Kiro Crew still ships it built in, and a second install under the same name is refused. This repository is the externally packaged copy of that app, with the same page markup; PORTING.md lists where the two differ.
data_notes: The screens the critic reads are fictional mockups of a made-up library app (Fernleaf Library), written for this README as HTML and rendered to PNG (capture/fixtures/). Every name, card number and the .example email address in them is invented.
They are handed to the page's own file picker, exactly as choosing them in the browser would; the page uploads them through the dashboard's upload endpoint.
Every critique and the follow-up answer came from a live model, so the wording, the findings and their count differ from run to run.
